entry_item.definition: n. Name given to certain heights, where according to legend, soldiers used to assemble before starting on warlike expeditions
T. hdu(s). M. converb of xura- translates T. hdus

example.definition: T. hdus byas; S. samskrta. Compound, conditioned, produced by a combination of causes, as the phenomena of sansar.
T. hdus ma byas; S. asamskrta. Uncompounded, unconditioned, as e.g. nirvana. See nom ud.
T. hdu çes; S. samjna .Ideations, ideas. See coγca.
T. hdu-byed; S. samskara. Constructive conditioning force or aggregate. See coγca. ED 543a.
